entries.title: Psalms 78:1
segments: ¶<<Maschil of Asaph.>> Give ear, O my people, [to] my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction}

words.text: . {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 78:2
segments: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

entries.title: Psalms 78:3
segments: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

entries.title: Psalms 78:4
segments: We will not hide [them] from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

entries.title: Psalms 78:5
segments: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

words.text: , that they should make them known

entries.title: Psalms 78:6
segments: That the generation to come might know [them, even] the children [which] should be born; [who] should arise and declare [them] to their children:

entries.title: Psalms 78:7
segments: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

entries.title: Psalms 78:8
segments: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation [that] set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God. {that...: Heb. that prepared not their heart}

words.text: And might not be as their fathers
. {that...: Heb. that prepared not their heart}

entries.title: Psalms 78:9
segments: ¶The children of Ephraim, [being] armed, [and] carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. {carrying: Heb. throwing forth}

entries.title: Psalms 78:10
segments: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

entries.title: Psalms 78:11
segments: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:12
segments: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:13
segments: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

words.text: , and caused them to pass through

entries.title: Psalms 78:14
segments: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:15
segments: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as [out of] the great depths.

entries.title: Psalms 78:16
segments: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 78:17
segments: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 78:18
segments: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:19
segments: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness? {furnish: Heb. order}

entries.title: Psalms 78:20
segments: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

entries.title: Psalms 78:21
segments: Therefore the LORD heard [this], and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

entries.title: Psalms 78:22
segments: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

entries.title: Psalms 78:23
segments: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

entries.title: Psalms 78:24
segments: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 78:25
segments: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full. {Man...: or, Every one did eat the bread of the mighty}

words.text: . {Man...: or, Every one did eat the bread of the mighty}

entries.title: Psalms 78:26
segments: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind. {to blow: Heb. to go}

entries.title: Psalms 78:27
segments: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea: {feathered...: Heb. fowl of wing}

entries.title: Psalms 78:28
segments: And he let [it] fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

entries.title: Psalms 78:29
segments: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

entries.title: Psalms 78:30
segments: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat [was] yet in their mouths,

entries.title: Psalms 78:31
segments: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen [men] of Israel. {smote...: Heb. made to bow} {Chosen...: or, young men}

words.text: . {smote...: Heb. made to bow} {Chosen...: or, young men}

entries.title: Psalms 78:32
segments: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 78:33
segments: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 78:34
segments: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:35
segments: And they remembered that God [was] their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

entries.title: Psalms 78:36
segments: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

entries.title: Psalms 78:37
segments: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

words.text: with him, neither were they stedfast

entries.title: Psalms 78:38
segments: But he, [being] full of compassion, forgave [their] iniquity, and destroyed [them] not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 78:39
segments: For he remembered that they [were but] flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

entries.title: Psalms 78:40
segments: ¶How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, [and] grieve him in the desert! {provoke: or, rebel against}

entries.title: Psalms 78:41
segments: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:42
segments: They remembered not his hand, [nor] the day when he delivered them from the enemy. {from...: or, from affliction}

entries.title: Psalms 78:43
segments: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan: {wrought: Heb. set}

entries.title: Psalms 78:44
segments: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

entries.title: Psalms 78:45
segments: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:46
segments: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:47
segments: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost. {destroyed: Heb. killed} {frost: or, great hailstones}

entries.title: Psalms 78:48
segments: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts. {gave...: Heb. shut up} {hot...: or, lightnings}

entries.title: Psalms 78:49
segments: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels [among them].

entries.title: Psalms 78:50
segments: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence; {He made...: Heb. He weighed a path} {life...: or, beasts to the murrain}

words.text: ; {He made...: Heb. He weighed a path} {life...: or, beasts to the murrain}

entries.title: Psalms 78:51
segments: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of [their] strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

entries.title: Psalms 78:52
segments: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 78:53
segments: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies. {overwhelmed: Heb. covered}

entries.title: Psalms 78:54
segments: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, [even to] this mountain, [which] his right hand had purchased.

entries.title: Psalms 78:55
segments: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:56
segments: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

entries.title: Psalms 78:57
segments: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

entries.title: Psalms 78:58
segments: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

words.text: For they provoked him to anger

entries.title: Psalms 78:59
segments: When God heard [this], he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

entries.title: Psalms 78:60
segments: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent [which] he placed among men;

entries.title: Psalms 78:61
segments: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

entries.title: Psalms 78:62
segments: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:63
segments: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage. {given...: Heb. praised}

entries.title: Psalms 78:64
segments: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:65
segments: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, [and] like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

entries.title: Psalms 78:66
segments: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 78:67
segments: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

entries.title: Psalms 78:68
segments: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

entries.title: Psalms 78:69
segments: And he built his sanctuary like high [palaces], like the earth which he hath established for ever. {established: Heb. founded}

entries.title: Psalms 78:70
segments: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

entries.title: Psalms 78:71
segments: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance. {following: Heb. after}

entries.title: Psalms 78:72
segments: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
